provider_to_confirm: Zoho or selected domain mail provider
principle: Only public mailbox names and purposes are documented here. No passwords, app codes, recovery addresses, private login addresses or account secrets are stored in the repository.

recommended_mailboxes.purpose: Main public contact address for GNK ASG portal visitors, partners, media and general inquiries.
Press releases, media inquiries and official public announcements.
GNK ASG Intelligence Desk inquiries and portal data questions.
Automated publishing status, daily insight notices and controlled editorial workflow.
Social channel administration and official network notifications.
Technical alerts, workflow failures and portal automation monitoring.

minimum_starting_setup: Add press@gnk-asg.hr if public press releases become a visible portal function.
Add publish@gnk-asg.hr and alerts@gnk-asg.hr only when automated email notices are enabled.
Use aliases or groups if the provider supports them, instead of paying for separate mailboxes where aliases are sufficient.
dns_items_to_prepare_later: SPF record for allowed sending servers
Provider verification TXT or CNAME record if required
